section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single sample of 249 college women recruited from a regional campus of a large Midwestern U.S. university (ages 18–28, M = 19.1). The sample is predominantly White (86.3%) and consists entirely of college students (100% college or higher inferred from description). No information about BMI, BMI assessment method, Body Appreciation assessment, survey method, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI is reported in this section.
